# Harriet Ainslie

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c21 P10](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Harriet is a tall woman of a grand, large frame with dark eyebrows and frozen, rigid steel-blue eyes. She possesses an agreeable, low, resonant voice accompanied by a robust laugh. Her face flushes to a radiant red when walking in the crisp winter air.

_Sources: [v5 c21 P10](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0010), [v5 c22 P8](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0008)_

## Personality

Harriet has a sharp sense of humor and a mind that matches well with intellectual conversations. She possesses a direct, grand truthfulness without ill will, small-mindedness, or a tendency to gossip about her neighbors. Extremely self-reliant and fond of staying at her own hearth, she is an active observer of politics and global affairs who enjoys lively, spirited debates.

_Sources: [v5 c21 P8](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0008), [v5 c21 P10](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0010), [v5 c21 P11](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0011), [v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c22 P3](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0003)_

## Traits

- Sharp sense of humor  <sub>[v5 c21 P8](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0008)</sub>
- Spirited and argumentative in debate  <sub>[v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c22 P3](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0003)</sub>
- Strong-willed and dominant  <sub>[v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066)</sub>
- Aversion to isolation  <sub>[v5 c22 P3](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0003)</sub>

## Abilities

- Keen comprehension of politics and global affairs  <sub>[v5 c21 P8](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0008)</sub>
- Skillful storytelling  <sub>[v5 c21 P10](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0010)</sub>

## History

Harriet lived in a remote house on the hill in Fern Hollow alongside her younger sister, Clementine. Over the years, she tended to dominate and protect Clementine, keeping a quiet domestic life while retaining her wealth and social standing. When the minister Rev. John Knox Ashdown courted Clementine, Harriet was almost always present during his evening visits, engaging him in intellectual conversations about politics and world events. Later, Harriet attended the silver wedding anniversary of the Pollocks, where she encountered Lionel Fairlie for the first time in social settings after many years. She engaged Lionel in a lively debate and soundly defeated him. Returning home at midnight in the moonlight, she discovered Clementine pacing inside the living room waiting to talk to her.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P65](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0065), [v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c21 P7](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0007), [v5 c21 P8](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0008), [v5 c21 P10](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0010), [v5 c22 P0](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0000), [v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c22 P4](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0004), [v5 c22 P5](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0005)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in a wealthy, strong Episcopalian family of Ainslies  <sub>[v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066)</sub>
- Remained at home with her sister Clementine following the death of their mother  <sub>[v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066)</sub>
- Was deeply hurt years ago by Lionel Fairlie's abrupt marriage  <sub>[v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001)</sub>

## Quotes

> I consider it just as good to maintain an interest in matters for the duration of your life. If you fail to do so, it appears to me that little distinguishes the living from the deceased.  <sub>[v5 c21 P9](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0009)</sub>

> I wish he possesses sufficient wisdom to return occasionally and act amicably.  <sub>[v5 c22 P3](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0003)</sub>
